channel: l1-zkevm-protocol/_threads/Replace the eager secured-trie path walk
searchText: I wasn't even considering a second preimage that encodes another trie to the same state root. As you said, if keccak were so broken, invalid depth nodes would be the least of our concern (!). I am inclined to drop the eager trie walk, in favor of only reject on invalid nodes read, and unread nodes have no bearing on accept/reject. This week, I'll sketch some execution-specs PR and share with both and maybe we can confirm better things with code.
